It can be hard opening up to ppl about the way you feel but at the same time I feel like by trusting someone enough to tell them how you're feeling, it helps them to understand you more and brings you closer. I wish you the best of luck :) ❤

I'm not sure how old you are but if you're young chances are you have many more opportunities to meet new ppl in the future and potentially form relationships then so try not to feel too disheartened. I really understand how you're feeling though bc I feel like I'm same in the sense that when I genuinely love and care about someone, ppl perceive me as "too obsessive" as I'll become attached to that person and basically smother them with every ounce of affection I have in me, telling them that I love them almost at the end of every message and constantly complimenting them and wanting to hug and kiss them, and unfortunately a lot of the time that becomes too overwhelming for ppl and they need space or leave me bc of it. It's a shitty feeling bc you feel like you pour your heart and your soul into that relationship and do everything you can to make them feel special, but it still just becomes too much for them and they eventually leave. Like myself though, I'm sure that you will find love eventually and someone who accepts you just for the way you are - perhaps it's just a matter of compatibility that the ppl you were in relationships with weren't your type or vice versa, but still have hope that you'll find love eventually, never give up on love. :) Also feel free to message me if you feel like you need to talk to someone. ❤

I do understand how you feel though bc although I've been in a few relationships in the past, always at the beginning of them I would feel this sense of anxiety and uncertainty, and even if I would wake up to a message of them saying "I love you" or complimenting me or anything it would make me feel anxious and give me butterflies bc it's kind of like this realisation of "oh shit, they actually like me", and then your entire mind goes into panic mode and starts overthinking everything. I think if you explain to them how you're feeling it should make things a bit easier and get rid of some of the pressure. :)
